entities.name: ANAS House-Museum of Huseyn Javid
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Huseyn Javid's House Museum is a scientific research institute incorporated into the Science Department of the Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences (ANAS). The museum was created at the house where Azerbaijani poet and playwright Huseyn Javid lived during 1920–1937.
